# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server log lines under the player-clip captures.
# map mp_carentan, g_gametype probe_bump (whose main() calls
# maps\mp\gametypes\dm::main()), probe_teleport 1, probe_overlap 1, dedicated 1,
# sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, stock scr_* defaults. Captured 2026-09-25.
# Clients: 0 a plain --net-probe that never joins (a spectator), 1 the target, 2 the walker.
# The evidence is the server's own games_mp.log, logged by
# crates/gsc/tests/fixtures/semantics/client-probes/probe_bump.gsc; the client
# half of the same run is mp_carentan-dm-bump-overlap-spectator-walker.txt beside this file.
#
# PROBE place <time> <clientNum> <team> <origin> <yaw>: a probe_teleport move.
# PROBE both_placed <time>: both players placed; the overlaps are at +12 s and +30 s.
# PROBE overlap <time> <target> <walker> <origin>: the target setorigin'd onto the
# walker's origin. PROBE state <time> <clientNum> <team> <origin> <isOnGround>:
# every playing player, every server frame from 1 s before to 3 s after each
# overlap; the frame's own state line comes before its setorigin. 1.1 gsc has
# no getvelocity, so velocities are the walker fixture's or the differences here.
#
# Recipe: as mp_carentan-dm-bump-script.txt with +set probe_overlap 1 on the
# server and --capture-tag overlap-spectator on the walker, with a plain
# `--net-probe 127.0.0.1:28985 --probe-secs 185` started 3 s before the target
# so it holds slot 0 and never joins.
